name: cscosine
description: Claude Code plugins of the cscosine organisation: how to work on its repositories and how to use its tools and libraries.

plugins.name: cs-org
plugins.description: How changes move in the cscosine repositories (branches, CI on demand, releases, the release train across repositories, fork syncs) and the state of a local workspace.

plugins.name: cscmake
plugins.description: How to use csCMake in a C++ project: the cs_* commands, packages with components, build configurations, compile profiles, presets and layouts, deployments, its error messages.

plugins.name: csorchestrator
plugins.description: How a cscosine project uses csorchestrator: its project script, providers of prebuilt libraries, the generated workflow, releases and manifests.

plugins.name: csfoundation
plugins.description: The csfoundation C++ libraries (csCore, csLie, csCamera, csVisOpenGL): which one for what, packages and components, how a project gets them.

plugins.name: csoptimization
plugins.description: The csoptimization C++ libraries (csNelson nonlinear least squares, csBlockMatrix block matrices): what they are for, packages, how a project gets them.
